head_coach.name: Fabio Cannavaro
head_coach.play_style_summary: Prioritizes a highly disciplined, defensively organized structure emphasizing compact lines and structured positioning. Focuses on organized defensive transitions to limit opponents' space, relying heavily on rapid transitions and vertical counter-attacks to exploit offensive spaces.

key_players.name: Abdukodir Khusanov
key_players.performance_stats: Played 42 games in the 2025/2026 season for Manchester City. Anchors the defense with exceptional strength and reading of the game, recording a 91.73% pass completion rate, 1,429 Premier League minutes, and keeping 19 clean sheets.

key_players.name: Eldor Shomurodov
key_players.performance_stats: Uzbekistan's captain and all-time top scorer. Had an incredibly clinical 2025/2026 season for Istanbul Basaksehir, scoring 22 goals to finish as joint-top scorer in the Turkish Süper Lig, showing exceptional hold-up play and aerial presence.

key_players.name: Abbosbek Fayzullaev
key_players.performance_stats: Dynamic, highly creative winger. Recorded 3 goals and 5 assists across 22 appearances in the 2025/2026 season for Istanbul Basaksehir. Outstanding in dribbling, key passes, and quick transitions down the flanks.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Excluded from the final 2026 World Cup 26-man roster due to a spinal disc herniation relapse (acute back injury) and replaced by Ruslanbek Jiyanov.
Missed the final tournament squad selection after undergoing knee surgery in February 2026.
Sidelined and excluded from the tournament roster due to an injury sustained during pre-tournament preparations.
